Policies.p11Content: The Pet Care Dog Dex system only collects necessary personal data including: Full Name, Phone Number, Email, and Delivery Address. This data is used when you register, purchase dog collars, or book pet care services.
Policies.p12Title: 1.2 Purpose of Data Use & Marketing Unsubscribe
Policies.p12Intro: Collected personal data is used for key purposes including:
Policies.p12Bullet1: Order confirmation, packaging, and collar delivery.
Policies.p12Bullet3: Sending promotional offers via Email or SMS Marketing.
Policies.p12Unsub: Unsubscribe right: You can click the "Unsubscribe" link at the bottom of any Marketing Email at any time.
Policies.p13Content: Dog Dex strictly commits to NOT SELL, RENT, OR EXCHANGE customer personal data. Shipping details are solely shared with official courier partners (such as GHTK, GHN, Viettel Post) to fulfill delivery.
Policies.t21Content: Customers commit to providing 100% accurate Name, Phone Number, and Shipping Address. Customers hold legal responsibility for declared information. We reserve the right to refuse service for fraudulent data.
Policies.t22Intro: All dog collar products and services are listed in VND.
Policies.t22CodDesc: Pay cash directly to the courier upon receiving and inspecting goods.
Policies.t22BankDesc: Fast transfer via official bank accounts or instant QR scanning.
Policies.r31Intro: 7 business days return policy applies from delivery date for the following cases:
Policies.r31Bullet1: Incorrect size, color, or wrong item delivered.
Policies.r32Bullet1: Items must have original tags and seals intact.
Policies.r32Bullet2: Unused, unwashed, and free of dirt or pet hair.
Policies.r32Bullet3: Strictly free of scratches, chew marks, or pet damage.
Policies.s41Content: Confirmed orders will be processed and packed within 1 to 2 business days (excluding Sundays and Public Holidays).
